entries.text: 100 Trying stops the retransmit. It is not ringing.
200 OK to INVITE is acknowledged with ACK. A 200 to BYE is not.
183 with SDP can be early media. 180 is alerting.
200 OK to CANCEL does not end the INVITE. Look for 487.
REFER asks the transferee to send a new INVITE.
The branch identifies a transaction. The tags identify the dialog.
SIP does not carry the voice. SDP names the media. RTP moves it.
G.722 RTP clock rate is 8000 even though the audio is 16 kHz.
telephone-event is the IETF digit mechanism in RTP. INFO is not the DTMF spec.
SRTP is RFC 3711. SDES (RFC 4568) and DTLS-SRTP (RFC 5764) are different keying paths.
Hold is a new offer. a=sendonly asks the other side to stop sending.
SIP does not replace workforce management, quality monitoring, CRM, or emergency policy. It is the session seam those systems hang from.
A voice bot still needs a session. SIP creates, modifies, and ends sessions. On Amazon Connect the platform owns the managed PSTN voice channel.

Lucky is a lifelong student and an AI enthusiast. The path into this campus ran through systems, networking, voice, and the contact center, and it is growing into AI omni-channel agents. That is the author's own description, not a vendor credential.
Cheat Codes are the one-page sheets and the printable flashcard deck in Downloads.
Example messages are synthetic. Addresses use the documentation ranges in RFC 5737. Phone numbers use 555.
Microsoft Teams Direct Routing, read 2026-10-15: signaling is TCP 5061 toward sip.pstnhub.microsoft.com, sip2.pstnhub.microsoft.com, and sip3.pstnhub.microsoft.com.
